info.title: Ablaki funded starter orders
info.description: Finite municipal demand for gatherable materials or published crop yields. The buyer fully reserves real budget. Delivery consumes selected backpack goods; payment enters the campsite treasury or, for a published crop yield, an owned unlocked bed's treasury when income_node_id is supplied. Expiry releases unused reserves.

IncomePolicy.description: Pinned income conditions with policy identity metadata. Existing published campsite conditions are preserved.
